baseline.kind: canonical scalar APIs from the same installed candidate wheel

configuration.input_generator: deterministic inclusive [0,1] grid, reshaped in C order
configuration.numpy_input: prepared ndarray or nested Python list, as named
configuration.scalar_input: flat Python list in both modes
configuration.unit: nanoseconds per batch, result allocation included

offline_wheel_install.exclusions: venv creation, download, bytecode compilation; filesystem cache not flushed

limitations: installed CI candidate on a shared host, not a published PyPI release
synthetic shapes; no authorized FMA/robot consumer trace available
memory observations are single samples, RSS is whole-process high water
no universal crossover or application throughput claim
fresh-process imports; verification reads package bytes before timing; filesystem caches are not flushed

provenance.git_field_meaning: package source identity proven against wheel bytes; installed wheels have no Git dirty state
provenance.source_report_adaptation: unchanged public builders/parity/paired timers; isolated installed memory/import dispatch and corrected provenance
